prompts.medal: Create one premium children's game currency coin icon on transparent background. Style reference ONLY attached colorful painted game objects: match polished hand-painted 3D illustration, rounded bevels, rich warm highlights, beautifully readable silhouette. One thick circular golden expedition medal, almost front-on with tiny visible bottom-right thickness, pale champagne gold face, amber gold rim with a fine rope-pattern border. Central embossed bold teal-blue ocean wave curling beneath one small golden four-point compass star. The wave and star are large simple pictograms, no letters, words, numbers, animals, ribbon, hole, pedestal, background, shadow outside silhouette, or floating decorations. Entire single coin centered with 12% transparent margin. This currency represents a children's beach-cleaning expedition. Memorable, cute and treasure-like, legible at 24px and beautiful at 100px.
prompts.beach: Create a text-free home background illustration for a children's beach-cleaning pet game, horizontal 3:2 composition. Match supporting reference's polished friendly hand-painted cartoon game rendering, soft rounded forms, lively turquoise and mint, warm cream sand, soft sunny lighting. A sheltered idyllic lagoon viewed slightly from above at child height: top 20% pale aqua sky and two fluffy clouds, tiny rounded green island on far left horizon and distant little sandy cove to right. Middle 55% clear turquoise shallow water, very calm with sparse softly painted ripples and subtle sunlit caustics. Bottom 25% gently curved cream-gold sandy shoreline, small smooth stones and two seashells only at extreme lower corners. Center 70% must remain uncluttered, open water and sand, for animated dolphin/turtle/hermit pets and separately rendered litter. Background environment only, absolutely NO characters, creatures, fish, birds, trash, bins, props, signs, lettering, words, logos, borders, frames, UI, captions or watermarks. No artificial vignette. Not a landscape photograph; a beautiful gentle painted game world.
